Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Contemporary Medallion Area Rug, 7' 10" x 10', Brick
Colors: Brick
Materials: stone
100% Polypropylene Imported Get the look of classic opulence with modern durability in this Persian style rug. Warm brick red tones highlight an intricate floral border that frames a traditional medallion pattern, giving this rug the finest antique look. Antique look with contemporary functionality Machine woven. Made in Turkey. 100% Polypropylene Exceptional durability for high traffic areas 7'10" x 10' Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow up to a week for synthetic fibers to settle
